PM-KISAN pays Rs. 6,000 a year. That helps a little with input cash but does not restore pumping or water access, which is the primary crisis (Paddy, 3.0 acres, non-energized borewell). Marginal value.

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card - Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (Central KCC-MISS via Commercial Banks / RRBs)
relevance_rationale: KCC-MISS gives short-term crop credit at 7% (effective lower with prompt repayment), which addresses the stated secondary constraint of depleted working capital. It cannot restore pumping, so capped at 2 under primary-crisis primacy. Credit-history eligibility is not recorded.
complementarity_notes: Pairs with a pump or water scheme; scored on its own merits.
